say:0:1012401001:0.text: The cave is dimly lit. Watch your step.
say:0:1012401001:0.source_cn: 洞穴内的光线很暗，大家注意脚下。

say:0:1012402001:0.text: Wind from the northeast. That may be the direction of the exit.
say:0:1012402001:0.source_cn: 风声从东北方传来，也许出口在那个方向。

say:0:1012403001:0.text: The wind is stronger here! We're going the right way!
say:0:1012403001:0.source_cn: 风声越来越大了，方向没错！我们离出口更近了。

say:0:1012404001:0.text: The wind is coming from the other side. We have to clear this.
say:0:1012404001:0.source_cn: 风声从对面传来，我们得想办法清除这些荆棘。

say:0:1012405001:0.text: Ha! It turns out there is still this trick.
say:0:1012405001:0.source_cn: 哈，原来还有这招。这就叫物尽其用吧。

say:0:1012406001:0.text: The exit is close! Why is there a glimmerbloom in the way?
say:0:1012406001:0.source_cn: 出口很近！怎么偏偏有一只荧荧花挡路啊……

say:0:1012407001:0.text: Toward the northeast! I see the exit!

say:1:1012408002:0.text: I heard it, too. There are a lot of people living here.
say:1:1012408002:0.source_cn: 我也听到了！附近住着不少人。

say:2:1012408003:0.text: Did we really find Ivoryshade? Let's go check it out.
say:2:1012408003:0.source_cn: 难道，我们真的找到了月影乡？去前面看看吧。

say:0:1012409001:0.text: It's my first time here, but somehow, this place feels so familiar... as if I've been here in a dream.
say:0:1012409001:0.source_cn: 我是第一次来这里，却总觉得很熟悉……仿佛在梦里来过。

say:0:1012410001:0.text: What a beautiful tree... Is this really Ivoryshade? We should talk to the people here.
say:0:1012410001:0.source_cn: 好美的树，这里究竟是不是月影乡呢？问问周围的居民吧。

say:1:1012412001:2.text: Incredible! I can't believe there are outlanders in Ivoryshade. We haven't had outlanders since my grandfather's generation.
say:1:1012412001:2.source_cn: 太神奇啦！竟然有外乡人到月影乡来，自打我爷爷那辈起，就...

say:2:1012412002:0.text: You all look tired. Would you like to sit down? Especially the handsome young man with the blindfold. Do you need a drink?
say:2:1012412002:0.source_cn: 你们看起来很疲惫，要不要坐一坐？尤其是那位蒙着眼睛的小...

say:4:1012412004:0.text:
Oh, the cold shoulder, huh? Now, you've piqued my interest.
What's your name? Are you, by any chance, betrothed?
say:4:1012412004:0.source_cn: 好冷淡哦，我更喜欢了！\n小哥哥，你叫什么名字？有没有...

say:5:1012412005:1.text: The men here are childish and not my type. I like deep, steady types like you!
say:5:1012412005:1.source_cn: 这里的男人都很幼稚，我不喜欢，我喜欢像你这样深沉稳重的类型！

say:6:1012412006:1.text: What do you mean deep and steady? He's clearly an expressionless clod...
say:6:1012412006:1.source_cn: 什么深沉稳重……分明是个面无表情的木头。

say:7:1012412007:2.text: You don't have a lot of experience, do you? You'll never understand the appeal of a mature man.
say:7:1012412007:2.source_cn: 哼，你也是幼稚的男人。因为你自己没长大，所以不理解成熟...

say:8:1012412008:2.text: Anyway, handsome stranger, I just finished baking. I have some cake for you if you want to come over.
say:8:1012412008:2.source_cn: 小哥哥，快来我家坐坐吧？我正好烤了蛋糕！

say:11:1012412010:1.text: Don't throw me to the wolves... Please help me...
say:11:1012412010:1.male: Don't throw me to the wolves... Please help me...
say:11:1012412010:1.female: Don't throw me to the wolves... Please help me...

say:12:1012412011:1.text: Do you find me that annoying...?
say:12:1012412011:1.source_cn: 小哥哥，你就那么讨厌我吗……

say:14:1012412013:1.text: Miss, sorry to interrupt... whatever this is. We actually came to Ivoryshade to seek the guidance of the Deer Spirit.
say:14:1012412013:1.source_cn: 姑娘……抱歉打断你的好兴致。其实，我们来到月影乡，是为...

say:15:1012412014:1.text: But we don't know what to do.
say:15:1012412014:1.source_cn: 可我们不知道该怎么做。

say:16:1012412015:2.text: Oh, you must go to the <style="highlight">Spirit Mound</style>. For it is only there that you may be able to hear the voice of the Deer Spirit.

say:17:1012412016:1.text: However, the gate to the Spirit Mound only opens on <style="highlight">Prayer Day</style>. You can't go right now.
say:17:1012412016:1.source_cn: 不过，通往鹿灵圣丘的大门只有<style=highli...

say:18:1012412017:1.text: It's in two days. Why don't you stay with me? I promise I'll be a good host.
say:18:1012412017:1.source_cn: 反正你们要等两天，不如先住在我家吧？我愿意招待你们！

say:19:1012412018:1.text: And you, handsome stranger, can take my bed.
say:19:1012412018:1.source_cn: 蒙眼睛的哥哥，我的床可以让给你！

say:20:1012412019:1.text:
...
Perhaps we ought to ask around first.

say:21:1012412020:1.text: Hey, don't go! I just want to get to know you!
say:21:1012412020:1.source_cn: 哎？！别走嘛……人家是真的很想认识你！

say:23:1012412012:1.text: Hmm... You seem nice, but the heart wants what the heart wants.
say:23:1012412012:1.source_cn: 嗯……虽然你好像也不错，但是人家就想要最喜欢的嘛。
say:23:1012412012:1.male: Hmm... You seem nice, but the heart wants what the heart wants.
say:23:1012412012:1.female: Hmm... You seem nice, but the heart wants what the heart wants.

say:1:1012413002:0.text: Out of all people, I didn't expect you to make a joke.

say:1:1012415001:1.text: Hurry up! Move this to the Spirit Mound! Wait, who are you?
say:1:1012415001:1.source_cn: 快快快！把这些东西搬到圣丘去——嗯？不对……你们是谁？

say:2:1012415002:1.text: Hello, sir. We've come from the Dark Forest.
say:2:1012415002:1.source_cn: 你好先生，我们从薄暮丛林来。

say:3:1012415003:1.text: That's strange. How did you all enter Ivoryshade? We haven't had outlanders here in a long, long time.
say:3:1012415003:1.source_cn: 真稀奇，你们是怎么进入月影乡的？我们这里很久很久都没出...

say:4:1012415004:1.text: How do I explain this...? A group of <style="highlight">black butterflies</style> guided us here.
say:4:1012415004:1.source_cn: 怎么向你解释呢……应该说，有一群<style=high...

say:5:1012415005:2.text: Black butterflies?! Are you sure?! This is not something you should joke about!
say:5:1012415005:2.source_cn: 黑、黑蝴蝶？！你们确定吗？这话可千万不能乱说啊！

say:6:1012415006:1.text: Sir, you seem nervous. What's wrong with black butterflies?
say:6:1012415006:1.source_cn: 这位先生，你好像很紧张，黑蝴蝶有什么问题呢？

say:7:1012415007:2.text: Misarte's avatar, the Deer Spirit, sends <style="highlight">blue butterflies as her messengers</style>.
say:7:1012415007:2.source_cn: 大地与河川之神……弥萨忒，鹿灵是祂的化身，<style...

say:8:1012415008:1.text: However, whenever the disaster strikes, she sends <style="highlight">black butterflies as a warning</style>.
say:8:1012415008:1.source_cn: 然而，每当灾厄即将降临……<style=highlig...

say:10:1012415009:1.text: Disaster...? Indeed, the Lucent Tree is in danger. That's why we've come to seek Misarte's guidance.
say:10:1012415009:1.source_cn: 灾厄吗……确实如此，因为流荧树遇到了危险，所以我们才来...

say:11:1012415010:1.text: The Lucent Tree! Although I've never been to the Dark Forest, I know that it's a sacred tree planted by Misarte herself!
say:11:1012415010:1.source_cn: 流荧树！虽然我从未去过薄暮丛林，但我知道那可是弥萨忒亲...

say:12:1012415011:1.text: How could the Lucent Tree be in danger? Did the Wilders of the Dark Forest not protect it properly?
say:12:1012415011:1.source_cn: 圣树怎么会遇到危险？薄暮丛林的人为什么没好好保护它！

say:14:1012415013:1.source_cn: 啊？你为什么要道歉？真是莫名其妙……

say:15:1012415014:1.text: In any case, if you wish to seek Misarte's guidance, you must go to the <style="highlight">Spirit Mound</style>. We have been watching over that divine altar for generations.
say:15:1012415014:1.source_cn: 总之，如果想要寻求弥萨忒的指引，必须得去<style=...

say:16:1012415015:1.text: The gate to the Spirit Mound is reachable through the <style="highlight">road behind the Ivory Tree</style>.

say:17:1012415016:1.text: But unfortunately, <style="highlight">Prayer Day</style> has not come yet, and you will not be able to enter.

say:0:1012416001:0.text: I hate it when you blame yourself for everything, Eironn.
say:0:1012416001:0.source_cn: 我讨厌你把一切都归咎于自己，埃隆。

say:1:1012418001:1.text: Sir, the situation is critical. We need Misarte's guidance.
say:1:1012418001:1.source_cn: 先生，情况危急，我们需要弥萨忒的指引。

say:2:1012418002:1.text: You are outlanders. No wonder you don't know the rules of Ivoryshade. Please allow me to explain.
say:2:1012418002:1.source_cn: 你们是外乡人吧？难怪不懂月影乡的规矩，没关系，请容我向...

say:3:1012418003:1.text: Only on the day of the full moon are we all welcome to pray at the altar of the Deer Spirit. On other days, the Spirit Mound is not open.
say:3:1012418003:1.source_cn: 只有满月那天，才允许大家去祭坛祈福，平日里，圣丘并不开放。

say:4:1012418004:1.text: This is a rule we've followed for generations. If you trespass, you will offend the goddess.
say:4:1012418004:1.source_cn: 这是我们世代遵守的规矩，如果私自闯入圣丘，便是冒犯神明。

say:5:1012418005:2.text: But the Lucent Tree is in danger... We cannot delay any longer. Can't you just bend the rules a bit?
say:5:1012418005:2.source_cn: 可是流荧树面临危险……我们不能再耽误了。能不能通融通融？

say:6:1012418006:1.text: Whatever your pressing concerns, please observe the rules in Ivoryshade. Ivoryshade welcomes all guests, but we will never tolerate the breaking of customs and traditions.
say:6:1012418006:1.source_cn: 无论你们有什么要紧事，还请遵守月影乡的规矩。月影乡欢迎...

say:7:1012418007:1.text: Seeds need time to blossom. We, who live in this land, should understand the need for patience.
say:7:1012418007:1.source_cn: 种子需要时间才能开出花朵。生活在这片土地的我们，不都懂...

say:8:1012418008:1.text: Prayer Day is fast approaching. Trust me, you won't have long to wait. Please return when it is time.
say:8:1012418008:1.source_cn: 而且祈福日马上就到了，相信我，你们不会等太久。眼下还是...

say:1:1012419001:1.text: There's no way to get close to the altar, and we can't do it the hard way. The people here are too nice and friendly. I can't imagine myself getting rough with them.
say:1:1012419001:1.source_cn: 不行啊……根本没法接近祭坛。总不能来硬的，这里的人都挺...

say:2:1012419002:1.text: Fortunately, Prayer Day is approaching soon, and then we can go to the Spirit Mound. In the meantime, it seems all we can do is wait.
say:2:1012419002:1.source_cn: 好在祈福日临近，那时，我们也能和大家一起进入圣丘。不过...

say:3:1012419003:2.text: Although the people here are friendly, they don't look anxious at all, which makes me very anxious...!
say:3:1012419003:2.source_cn: 虽然这里的人很友好，可他们一点也不着急的样子让我很着急……！

say:4:1012419004:1.text: The corruption outside is very serious, yet these people here are so laid back!
say:4:1012419004:1.source_cn: 明明外面的腐化已经很严重了……这里的人却很悠哉！

say:6:1012419005:1.text: Hammie, you gotta be patient with them. Ivoryshade hasn't been corrupted. They have nothing to be worried about.
say:6:1012419005:1.source_cn: 漫漫……收收你的急性子。月影乡没受到影响，他们也没什么...

say:7:1012419006:2.text: Chippy is right. Life in Ivoryshade is peaceful. The people here do not feel a sense of doom approaching.
say:7:1012419006:2.source_cn: 满满说的没错，月影乡的生活平和安逸，因此，这里的人们缺...

say:8:1012419007:1.text: Even if something strange is happening outside, they aren't affected. It's difficult for them to understand how serious this new danger is.
say:8:1012419007:1.source_cn: 就算外界出现异样，不受影响的他们，也很难相信那是多么严...

say:10:1012419008:1.text: Do you have any ideas at the moment, Eironn?
say:10:1012419008:1.source_cn: 埃隆，眼下你有什么办法吗？

say:13:1012419011:1.text: As the Scion of the Lucent Tree... I couldn't do anything to prevent the corruption...
say:13:1012419011:1.source_cn: 身为流荧树之子……我却对流荧树的危机束手无策……

say:16:1012419013:1.text: Oh, no! She's about to blow! Lyca, please calm down...
say:16:1012419013:1.source_cn: 糟、糟糕……她要发火了！姐，你快消消——

say:18:1012419015:1.text: Why did we come to Ivoryshade, Eironn?! Is it because we're all weak and incompetent?! We're now forced to seek help from Misarte?! Is that what you think?!
say:18:1012419015:1.source_cn: 埃隆，我们为什么要来月影乡？是因为我们无能？逼不得已，...

say:19:1012419016:1.text: Magister Merlin did everything he could! We all tried our best! Me, Bryon, Lorsan, and everyone else... are we all just a burden to you?
say:19:1012419016:1.source_cn: 梅林大人已经竭尽全力了！我们试图挽救！我、布莱恩、洛桑...
say:19:1012419016:1.male: Magister Merlin did everything he could! We all tried our best! Me, Bryon, Lorsan, and everyone else... are we all just a burden to you?
say:19:1012419016:1.female: Magister Merlin did everything she could! We all tried our best! Me, Bryon, Lorsan, and everyone else... are we all just a burden to you?

say:20:1012419017:1.text: I never thought that, Lyca. You're mistaken.
say:20:1012419017:1.source_cn: 我从未这样想，莱卡，你误会了。

say:21:1012419018:1.text: You just don't understand... When you belittle yourself, you belittle us as well. This is not a responsibility you can carry alone! Stop being so arrogant!
say:21:1012419018:1.source_cn: 你根本不懂……当你轻视自己，也是在轻视我们。因为这不是...

say:22:1012419019:1.text: You claim to be doing it for the sake of the Dark Forest and the Lucent Tree. Yet, in your eyes, you only see yourself!
say:22:1012419019:1.source_cn: 你口口声声说为了薄暮丛林，为了流荧树。然而在你的眼中，...

say:23:1012419020:1.text: If you intend to remain so dispirited, take your sword and get out of my sight! I don't ever want to see you again!
say:23:1012419020:1.source_cn: 如果你打算继续消沉下去，现在就拿着你的剑从我眼前离开，...

say:24:1012419021:1.text:
Scion of the Lucent Tree...
I'll never attest to it!
say:24:1012419021:1.source_cn: 什么流荧树之子……\n我……莱卡！决不认可！

say:28:1012419023:1.text:
Eironn... What are you doing?
You're leaving too?! Eironn!
say:28:1012419023:1.source_cn: 埃隆……你到底在搞什么？\n埃隆？怎么连你也走了！

say:32:1012419025:1.text: My ability to soothe individuals is lacking. I won't be of much use. However, I do understand Lyca's anger.
say:32:1012419025:1.source_cn: 我不擅长平息怒火，帮不上忙。但是，我能理解莱卡的愤怒。

say:33:1012419026:1.text: Eironn has always been a lone swordsman who never relied on anyone, not even us, his companions. Does he have no faith in us?
say:33:1012419026:1.source_cn: 埃隆是孤高的剑士，他不想依赖任何人……甚至是，我们这些...

say:34:1012419029:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't think those two will actually become enemies, right?
say:34:1012419029:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't think those two will actually become enemies, right?
say:34:1012419029:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't think those two will actually become enemies, right?

choice_prompt:35:1012419029.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't think those two will actually become enemies, right?
choice_prompt:35:1012419029.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，他们两个不会真的从此变成敌人吧？
choice_prompt:35:1012419029.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't think those two will actually become enemies, right?
choice_prompt:35:1012419029.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't think those two will actually become enemies, right?

say:36:1012419030:1.text: Ah, it's not the time for jokes right now. You're making me all worried...
say:36:1012419030:1.source_cn: 哎呀！我都急得不行了，你还和我开玩笑……
say:36:1012419030:1.male: Ah, it's not the time for jokes right now. You're making me all worried...
say:36:1012419030:1.female: Ah, it's not the time for jokes right now. You're making me all worried...

say:37:1012419032:1.text: There's nothing else we can do. Let's split up first.
say:37:1012419032:1.source_cn: 唉，这么下去也不是个办法……我们还是先分头行动吧。

say:38:1012419033:1.text: I'm going to try to convince people of the dangers of the corruption.
say:38:1012419033:1.source_cn: 我去试着说服大家，让他们了解腐化的危害。

say:39:1012419034:1.text: There seems to be a lot of noise around that big white tree. Maybe something happened. Why don't you go over there and take a look?
say:39:1012419034:1.source_cn: 白色大树附近很吵闹，说不定有什么事情发生，你去那边看看吧？
say:39:1012419034:1.male: There seems to be a lot of noise around that big white tree. Maybe something happened. Why don't you go over there and take a look?
say:39:1012419034:1.female: There seems to be a lot of noise around that big white tree. Maybe something happened. Why don't you go over there and take a look?

say:40:1012419035:1.source_cn: 之后，我也会过去找你的！拜托啦！

choice:35:0:1.text: That would be an epic fight...
choice:35:0:1.male: That would be an epic fight...
choice:35:0:1.female: That would be an epic fight...

choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 好问题……布莱恩，你觉得呢？

say:44:1012419028:1.text: Eironn has always been a lone swordsman who never relied on anyone, not even us, his companions. Does he have no faith in us?
say:44:1012419028:1.source_cn: 埃隆是孤高的剑士，他不想依赖任何人……甚至是，我们这些...

say:0:1012420001:0.text: Lorsan told us to check out the Ivory Tree.
say:0:1012420001:0.source_cn: 按洛桑说的，先去皎月树附近看看。
say:0:1012420001:0.male: Lorsan told us to check out the Ivory Tree.
say:0:1012420001:0.female: Lorsan told us to check out the Ivory Tree.

say:0:1012421001:0.text: If we don't do anything, Prayer Day will be postponed!
say:0:1012421001:0.source_cn: 怎么办……祈福日要延期了！

say:1:1012422001:1.text: Prayer Day is coming! As a rule, we need to dance for the Deer Spirit!
say:1:1012422001:1.source_cn: 祈福日马上到了，按照规矩，我们要在圣丘跳舞，为鹿灵助兴！

say:2:1012422002:1.text: <style="highlight">One of our dancers</style> is missing! Her friend asked her to go pick flowers, but she never returned! I can't find her anywhere!

say:3:1012422003:1.text: If the prayer dance doesn't happen, the ceremony won't be held on time! What should we do...?
say:3:1012422003:1.source_cn: 祈福舞跳不成，祈福仪式就不能按时举办了！这可怎么办……

say:4:1012422004:1.text: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!
say:4:1012422004:1.source_cn: 主人！如果祈福日延期，我们就要在月影乡待到下一次满月了！
say:4:1012422004:1.male: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!
say:4:1012422004:1.female: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!

choice_prompt:5:1012422004.text: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!
choice_prompt:5:1012422004.source_cn: 主人！如果祈福日延期，我们就要在月影乡待到下一次满月了！
choice_prompt:5:1012422004.male: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!
choice_prompt:5:1012422004.female: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!

say:6:1012422005:2.text: Really? That's very kind of you! Thank you so much!
say:6:1012422005:2.source_cn: 真的吗？你可真是个大好人！太谢谢你了！
